gloss: in order; sequentially; one after another

definitions.gloss: in order; sequentially; one after another
definitions.explanation: Describes actions or events happening in a set order or sequence, one at a time. Implies a systematic, organized progression.

examples.japanese: {順次|じゅんじ}⟦{発送|はっそう}→発送：10458_hassou⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: We will ship them out in order.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{順次|じゅんじ}⟦{切|き}り{替|か}えて→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧いく⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: We plan to switch to the new system gradually, one step at a time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応募者|おうぼしゃ}→応募者：20440_oubosha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{順次|じゅんじ}⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We will inform applicants of interview dates one by one in order.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal adverb commonly used in business, administrative, and official communication. Indicates that something will happen in sequence rather than all at once. Often used to manage expectations — "we'll get to it in order" rather than immediately.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {順次|じゅんじ}⟦{発送|はっそう}する→発送する：21737_hassousuru⟧ (to ship in order)
- {順次|じゅんじ}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to handle in sequence)
- {順次|じゅんじ}⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to release sequentially)
- {順次|じゅんじ}⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to expand gradually)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: one after another — emphasizes rapid, continuous succession rather than orderly sequence
- ⟦{段階的|だんかいてき}→段階的：06174_dankaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in stages — emphasizes distinct phases rather than sequential processing
